task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Lower the left arm onto the stapler the white body stapler with accents.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架将左臂降低到订书机上，带有口音的白色主体订书机。
